description: Diabetes Mellitus is a chronic disease associated with abnormally high levels of the sugar glucose in the blood. The two main types of diabetes correspond to these two mechanisms and are called insulin dependent (type 1) and non-insulin dependent (type 2) diabetes. In type 1 diabetes there is no insulin or not enough of it. In type 2 diabetes, there is generally enough insulin but the cells upon which it should act are not normally sensitive to its action.

description: Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA) and Hyperosmolar Hyperglycemic Nonketotic Syndrome (HHNS) are serious diabetes complications. DKA, mainly in type 1 diabetes, involves ketones making blood acidic due to insufficient insulin. HHNS, typically in type 2 diabetes, features extreme high blood sugar without significant ketones. Both require different management strategies despite sharing hyperglycemia.

description: Discover key steps of study planning, manage test anxiety, and prioritize questions effectively in this must-watch series opener. Jumpstart your journey to becoming a safe, competent nurse with Mike’s strategic insights on the NCLEX.
They key to unlocking safe practice standards with prioritization and delegation, crucial concepts that stand the test of time in every NCLEX iteration.

Understand the essentials of top tested key points on HIPAA, legal and ethical standards. Nurse Mike guides you through all the key words ensuring you’re well-equipped for both the NCLEX and real-world dilemmas.
Master complex ABGs with ease, a critical skill for the NCLEX and ensuring patient safety. Simplify the confusion of acid-base imbalances with Nurse Mike’s engaging rundown.

Finally understand electrolytes imbalances with simple memory tricks that will have you smiling! Nurse Mike will help you master electrolyte once and for all in a fun and easy way, a must for nclex success!

Solidify your understanding of lab values! Recognize critical values and when your patient is in danger. Nurse Mike helps you grasp this vital skill in analyzing and prioritizing the never ending lab numbers, a cornerstone of nclex prep and patient care!
Ace pharmacology with ease! Master the top tested NCLEX drug, dosages, drug actions and contraindications through fun mnemonic devices for quick memorization success!
Discover the important steps to shock management, CPR, and extreme temperature injuries, crucial tools for nclex and real-world emergency excellence!
Embark on mastering nursing essentials with dosage calculations, aseptic techniques, nutrition, IV therapy troubleshooting, oxygenation, and lung sounds in this foundational NCLEX prep video.
Protect yourself and patients with our Infectious Disease & PPE guide, highlighting essential NCLEX precautions and care scenarios involving contagious diseases.
Deep dive into respiratory care with Mike’s walkthrough of conditions, treatments, and NCLEX-focused airway management strategies.
Navigate the intricacies of cardiac health, from condition management to EKG interpretation, in this comprehensive guide to acing cardiology questions on the NCLEX.
Master renal system intricacies, including anatomy and common pathologies like renal failure, with our focused NCLEX prep session.
Dissect the complexities of the endocrine system, from hormonal disorders to acute emergencies, in this detailed exploration tailored for NCLEX success.
From stoma care to managing GI emergencies, our session on gastrointestinal health equips you with the know-how to handle NCLEX questions confidently.
Enhance your clinical skills with our in-depth guide on hepatobiliary and pancreatic disorders, essential for NCLEX mastery and effective patient care.
Equip yourself with hematology know-how, covering transfusions to clotting disorders, vital for passing the NCLEX and delivering expert patient care.
Develop a robust understanding of oncology nursing, focusing on patient safety and cancer care complexities, an essential piece of your NCLEX preparation.
Prep for NCLEX with our skin care module, exploring burn management, wound care, and the critical 'rule of nines.'
Build your musculoskeletal knowledge base, from amputation care to arthritis management, essential for NCLEX success and safe nursing practice.
Tackle neurological challenges with confidence, from increased intracranial pressure protocols to managing neurodegenerative disorders, crucial for your NCLEX strategy.
Sharpen your skills in ophthalmic and otic health, addressing everything from injuries to medication administration techniques, a must for NCLEX proficiency.
Navigate mental health care with Mike’s insights on prioritizing patient needs, therapeutic communication, and crisis management for the NCLEX.
Elevate your pediatric nursing abilities, covering development to disease management, ensuring you’re well-prepared for pediatric questions on the NCLEX.
Master maternity nursing from pregnancy to postpartum care, with Mike’s guidance on critical assessments like GTPAL and APGAR for NCLEX excellence.
Discover the nuances of male and female reproductive health in this comprehensive guide, enriching your NCLEX prep with expert-level insights into gender-specific care.
